newsitem.title: USA: Webster Financial Corp Feb 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Webster Financial Corp Feb 1997 results.

text.p: Webster Financial Corp posted its net income for the month of February 1997.
Net income was reported at $2.9 million or $0.24 per fully diluted share before non-recurring items compared to net income of $2.5 million or $0.19 per fully diluted share for February 1996.

With the inclusion of the $25.5 million previously-announced non-recurring charges related to the acquisition of DS Bancor Inc, Webster had a net loss of $12.1 million in Febraury, or $1.00 per fully diluted share.

Webster, a holding company for Waterbury-based Webster Bank, usually reports earnings on a quarterly basis but February earnings are being reported as a condition of the DS Bancor acquisition, acquired on January 31 1997 and converted to Webster's systems on February 18 1997.
Webster has $5.4 billion in assets at Febraury 28 1997.
